_comment: The online lobby every copy of the game uses for Create room, Join by code and Quick Match. Since 0.23.0 it is the WebSocket lobby on Render (wss://bslegacy-lobby.onrender.com); the web build's lobby.json beside index.html can override it without a rebuild. Leave the address empty to have no online lobby: rooms are then hosted on the player's own computer (desktop only).
